title: Design: A/R Detail chevron button, tooltips and pinned group row
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Make sure the report has open documents in several buckets on today's date, one with more lines than fit on the screen.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, in light theme at 100% zoom.
  • Open A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with every group collapsed.
custom_steps:
1. Look at the table's top-left header cell.
  2. Look at each bucket row's own chevron.
  3. Hover over the top-left chevron button.
  4. Click it.
  5. Hover over it again.
  6. Scroll down through the tallest bucket.
  7. Switch ShopView to dark theme.
  8. Hover over the top-left chevron button.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • One chevron button, the design system's chevron icon, in the top-left header cell, pointing right (every group collapsed).

Step 2:

  • Every bucket row shows the same chevron, pointing right when closed.

Step 3:

  • A tooltip above the button reads "Expand all", letter for letter.

Step 4:

  • Every bucket opens and its chevron points down.

Step 5:

  • The tooltip above the button reads "Collapse all".

Step 6:

  • The bucket's row stays pinned just under the column headings, with its label visible at the left.

Step 7:

  • The page switches to dark theme.
  • The pinned row is readable.

Step 8:

  • The tooltip sits above the button and is readable in dark theme.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows)

  • S4-R1: “The table's top-left header cell holds one chevron button. While any group is expanded it points down, its tooltip (above the button) reads "Collapse all", and a click collapses every group. When every group is collapsed it points right, its tooltip reads "Expand all", and a click expands every group.”
  • S4-R5: “Each group's own expand toggle uses the same chevron: pointing down when open, right when closed. Behavior is unchanged.”
  • S4-R6: “While the user scrolls through an expanded group, that group's row (the bucket label, customer or vendor) stays pinned just under the column headings. Only one group row is held at a time: when the next group's row reaches it, the next row pushes it up and off and takes its place. Scrolling back reverses this.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Collapse all / Expand all button | "Collapse all" / "Expand all" | Tooltip above the button”
  • Key Decisions, reuse rule: “The reuse rule. Every control on these reports reuses an existing ShopView pattern: the native filter chips, the native totals row and pinned headline column of the newer reports, the existing location-switch prompt, the design system's chevron icon. Nothing new is drawn. Basis: d-reuse-existing-pattern.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 3 "Collapse all and pinned group rows" (board Grouped.dc.html); page 4 "Location filter and Location column" (board Location.dc.html); page 5 "Document links and Switch location" (board Links.dc.html). The design shows the chevrons on A/R Detail but no picture of the Collapse all / Expand all tooltip.

  • ar-ap-p5-links-only-where-they-can-open.png: figure "Links only where they can open" (This build (after)), board "5. Document links and Switch location (SV-5706)"

The design's own words:

  • "Native filter row: As of, Customer, Past due, then Location, which opens on "Location: All locations". Untouched, the report matches today. Column labelled "Location", after Date. S5-R1, S5-R2, S5-R5, S6-R1 to S6-R3." (caption of "Opens on All locations")
  • "A number links only with the right permission and a location the user works at; otherwise plain text. Native link style. S7-R1, S7-R2, S7-R6, S7-R7, S7-N1, S7-N2." (caption of "Links only where they can open")
  • "Each customer opens with its own arrow; there is no way to open or close them all." (caption of "A/R Collection, groups opened one by one")
